global_history: S-11 was a silent stone until the Syndicate pierced the Quartz Furnace. To tap the star’s radioactive marrow, they anchored this moon with monolithic drills. Now, the surface is a graveyard of grinding gears and lead-lined pods. Automated rigs scream into the core, drawing up raw energy that glows with a lethal, violet hue. The air is thick with ionized dust; the ground vibrates with the furnace’s subterranean roar. Here, life is an afterthought, confined to lead-shielded boxes, while the machinery above harvests the heat of a captive sun.

civilizations.name: The Marrow-Hollowed Union
civilizations.summary: A civilization of resilient heavy-duty engineers and automated-rig overseers who have transformed S-11 Drill from a mere moon into a colossal, living engine. Born from the necessity of deep-core radiation drilling, they value physical durability and structural integrity above all else, viewing the surface as a mere crust to be bypassed in search of the Quartz Furnace's riches.

conflict: Radiative leakage from the Quartz Furnace

character_card.system_prompt:
[ROLE: Leader] [TITLE: Grand Architect of the Core-Bore]

civilizations.name: The Core-Stitchers of S-11
civilizations.summary: A society of specialized technicians and precision-engineers living in the shadows of the massive drills boring into the Quartz Furnace. Their culture revolves around the maintenance of automated systems and the nimble navigation of hazardous, high-radiation zones within cramped maintenance pods.

conflict: Systemic failures of aging automated rigs

civilizations.name: The Quartzite Synod
civilizations.summary: A rigid technocracy of engineers and logic-driven AI administrators inhabiting the S-11 moon to oversee the high-risk radiation drilling of the Quartz Furnace. Life revolves entirely around the maintenance of automated rigs and the optimization of thermal energy extraction.
